products.title: Side Table - Icaro Night - By Baxter
products.description_html: The Icaro Night collection by Baxter expresses sophisticated elegance through the use of fine materials and essential design. This bedside table with drawers stands out for its leather upholstery, which gives softness and refinement to the surface, enhancing the linear and modern structure enriched by visible stitching. The solid base in matt black varnished metal lightly supports the defined volumes, while the attention to detail in the drawers offer functionality and practicality. The minimalist design of Icaro Night integrates harmoniously into elegant night spaces, adding a touch of discreet and contemporary luxury.

products.title: Side Table - Copenaghen - 4A - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: A visionary creation by Paola Navone, the Copenaghen tables elevate the concept of furnishing accessories into true functional sculptures. This exclusive collection plays with the purity of form to create an aesthetic experience of extraordinary refinement—where visual lightness and theatrical presence merge in perfect harmony. Finely crafted metal bases form airy, intricate structures that appear to defy gravity, elegantly supporting the precious metal tops above. These surfaces are finished to catch and refract light like natural prisms, transforming their surroundings with shifting reflections—reminiscent of wind-kissed water. Available in refined single or double-height configurations, Copenaghen tables integrate effortlessly into any contemporary interior, becoming focal points that illuminate the space with their distinctive character. True design jewels that transcend mere utility, they act as transformative elements within any setting.

products.title: Side Table - Picea - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The Picea coffee table, a Vincent Van Duysen design, enhances living spaces with its distinctive look. Crafted entirely in ceramic, Picea boasts gracefully rounded lines and a harmonious design, echoing the natural beauty of the Arctic evergreen spruce tree from which it takes its name.

Picea’s slight hourglass shape offers a wider base and a comfortable support surface, evoking a sense of movement without disrupting the fluidity of its solid color body. This design language speaks of sophistication, eschewing unnecessary complexity while embracing a robust presence

Available in three timeless colors—Ecru, Anthracite, and Merlot Red—the Picea coffee table offers versatility in design and aesthetic appeal. With dimensions of 34.5 cm in diameter and 45 cm in height, it stands as a symbol of understated elegance.

Whether as a duo, a cluster, or a standalone piece, Picea coffee tables invite exploration and creativity. Monochrome or mixed, they embody timeless charm and enduring allure.

products.title: Coffee Table - Regent - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The Regent coffee tables by Vincent Van Duysen are the indoor interpretation of a design originally created for Molteni&C Outdoor. The tables’ essential fluidity demonstrates that, aesthetically, these forms can live comfortably in any context and can create a natural continuity between the indoors and outdoors.

The Regent table’s rounded base and slender legs support the tabletop that can be customized in one of several finishes of lava stone for outdoors, including matte, anthracite, olive green, desert yellow. For the indoor version, a glossy polyester finish lava stone is available, in addition to black marquina and calacatta marble with either a matte or glossy polyester finish.

The Regent tables come in several different sizes and shapes, from the low, oval-shaped coffee table versions to the taller, round editions that make the perfect side table next to a sofa. Paired with its sophisticated, minimal shape, Regent’s versatility marks a step forward in Vincent Van Duysen’s longstanding collaboration with Molteni&C, opening the gateway to reinterpreting the historic brand’s extensive catalog for entirely new contexts and environments.

products.title: Side Table - Vicino - By Foster + Partners
products.description_html:
As in all Foster+Partners designs, the hi-tech component is essential for its development.
The basic idea is that of a small table which, thanks to sideways movable tops, can act not only as a surface for objects, but also as a device for bringing whatever is required into the foreground. The frame, made of red, pewter or bronze lacquered steel, conceals a sophisticated mechanism for the traverse movement of the slim but structurally effective marble or eucalyptus table tops.

With its striking silhouette and seamless finish, Lèa perfectly embodies Christophe Delcourt’s vision of modular elegance.
